verdict.rationale: Remote documents a public REST API on developer.remote.com. Docs cover concrete endpoints (`POST /v1/employments` with per-country dynamic JSON schemas), token and OAuth authentication with per-integration scoping, a sandbox with a test token, two-way data sync, and webhooks. An llms.txt index of the API docs is live. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes at common paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
